description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall, Precision, and F1 Score for three different models: (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The horizontal axis represents the evaluation metric—Recall, Precision, and F1 Score—listed in that order, with each metric having a corresponding bar group. The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each metric, there are three bars representing the models; the (zero-shot) model is light blue, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) model is dark blue, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) model is light green.  For Recall, the (zero-shot) bar is approximately 63.58 units tall, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is approximately 71.90 units tall, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is approximately 72.29 units tall. For Precision, the (zero-shot) bar is approximately 88.89 units tall, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is approximately 91.24 units tall, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is approximately 92.31 units tall. For F1 Score, the (zero-shot) bar is approximately 75.34 units tall, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is approximately 80.40 units tall, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is approximately 81.08 units tall. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each metric, and within each group, the models are consistently ordered as (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
